name: Emotional Release
intro: Welcome. This is a safe space.
Whatever you've been holding, you have permission to set it down here.
We carry so much. Feelings we didn't have time for. Words we never said.
Right now, nothing is expected of you except to breathe and feel.
If emotions come, let them. They're not weakness. They're release.
body: Place your hand on your chest if it feels right.
Feel the warmth of your own touch. You are your own safe harbor.
Now ask yourself: What have I been holding that I haven't let myself feel?
Don't force an answer. Just open the door and see what walks through.
Whatever it is, it's welcome here.
Sometimes we armor up to survive. We had to. It was necessary.
But armor that protects can also trap.
Imagine slowly removing one piece. Just one.
What's underneath it? What feeling has been waiting there?
Let it breathe. It's been compressed for too long.
Emotions live in the body. Where do you feel yours right now?
A tightness in the throat? A heaviness in the chest? A knot in the stomach?
Breathe directly into that spot. Imagine your breath reaching it.
You're not trying to make it go away. You're giving it attention.
Often, all a feeling needs is to be acknowledged.
If tears come, let them come. Tears are not falling apart. They're letting go.
If anger comes, let it be here too. It has a voice. What is it saying?
If sadness comes, welcome it like an old friend who's been standing at the door.
None of these feelings can hurt you. They've been hurting you by staying hidden.
Let them move through you. That's all they want to do.
Imagine gathering everything you've been carrying into a bundle.
Every expectation. Every disappointment. Every should-have and what-if.
Hold the bundle for a moment. Feel its weight.
Now imagine setting it down. Gently. On the ground beside you.
You can pick it back up later if you need to. But for now, your hands are free.
closing: What you just did takes immense courage.
Feeling is the bravest thing a person can do.
You may feel lighter now, or you may feel raw. Both are right.
Be gentle with yourself for the rest of today. You've done deep work.
Open your eyes when you're ready. You are a little freer now.
